name: Gulf / US–Iran war
value: Iranian-made drone hit Kuwait site 26 Nov
summary: Italy says a Kuwaiti inquiry shows an Iranian-made drone killed two Italians on 26 Nov; Iran denies it
state: Italian foreign minister Tajani said on 28 Nov that Kuwaiti investigations confirm the drone that killed two Italian technicians at a Kuwaiti radar site on 26 Nov was made in Iran; Tehran denies launching it and offers a joint inquiry (Al Jazeera, NBC News). Kuwait summoned Iran's ambassador, and Italy said it will relocate its troops from Kuwait (Arab Times). Attacks on Gulf states and shipping keep the Alert.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Kuwait and the Gulf states, and register for alerts if you are in the region. Fuel and shipping costs remain exposed to further attacks.
rubric_hit: Active strikes on Gulf states and shipping = Alert

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
